summary_en: QUICK executed a block acquisition of 400,000 shares (0.72% of outstanding shares) at 863 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3 on November 13, 2026, for a total of 345.2 million yen as part of its plan to acquire 3 billion yen or more in treasury stock over the three fiscal years ending March 2029.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Stock and Purchase of Treasury Stock through Off-Hours Trading System (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief:
QUICK's Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock through off-hours trading on November 13, 2026. The company executed a block purchase of 400,000 shares at the closing price of 863 yen per share via ToSTNeT-3, generating a total outlay of 345.2 million yen. This execution represented 0.72% of the company's outstanding shares (excluding treasury stock), calculated against the 55,925,964 shares outstanding as of October 31, 2026.

The acquisition was conducted as part of QUICK's capital policy framework to acquire 3 billion yen or more in treasury stock cumulatively over the three fiscal years from FY2027 through FY2029. The purchase order was placed at 8:45 a.m. on the Tokyo Stock Exchange's ToSTNeT-3 platform and was limited to that specific trading session. As of the disclosure date, the company held 626,064 treasury shares, excluding 416,889 shares held by the employee stock ownership plan trust.
